label: s1_final
prompt:
SHOT: one continuous unbroken crane move from about 10 metres up, descending smoothly over the full 6 seconds to eye level, ending on the woman exactly as in the last frame, 24mm lens, 25 fps.
SUBJECT AND ACTION: the first raindrops fall on a busy city street; cars and buses pass, pedestrians hurry by with umbrellas; the camera settles on the young woman from the last frame, dark brown hair, tan camel coat, standing still with her arms crossed.
PLACE: a four-lane street, the large glass office building with a revolving door behind her, autumn leaves on the wet pavement.
LIGHT: one soft key from a grey overcast autumn morning sky, about 4:1, soft reflections on the wet street, warm light from the office lobby, expose to protect the highlights.
COLOUR: cool greys and slate blue, the tan coat as the one warm accent, natural skin.
SOUND: city traffic, a passing bus, the first drops pattering and growing louder.
